semantic_base: Verified original Japanese; English reference only
method: Direct handwritten Vietnamese after reading complete selected ordinary scenes/branches. Mixed sexual scenes screened for boundaries only and frozen. No MT/bulk pronoun pipeline.
register: Menad em/anh to Zarak; Zarak anh/em manipulative ordinary dialogue. Rance ta/cô to Haurein, ta/ngươi to Barres. Haurein tôi/Bệ hạ in service, hostile imperatives when captive; con/cha in family argument. Barres cha/con, lão thần/Bệ hạ. Fuuka tôi/ngài Rance.
meaning_corrections: Menad’s confidence is in the king, not Zarak; she wants to live with him and have a family, not the reversed male/female version.
Haurein called beautiful rather than an invented sexual insult; Barres’ last mercy is letting her die by her father’s sword, not no mercy. Barres restored from Thanh chắn.
Peace: the aggressor should bow and apologize, not a comparison between Rance fighting and bowing. Ex is a general, not a generic introduction.
Matchmaking 釣り書き means candidate profiles, not the past. Rance tells father to detach from daughter, not let her leave first.
Fuuka fortune branches and existing correct Japanese-based ordinary revisions retained; current number-plus-period composition checked.
